gate: G5 Stage 1 - EgoStitch E2E stitched-topology-conditioned pair encoder

b0_e2e_f_only.note: permanent ∅_all_head; the matched pairwise-only control - the only arm '-topology' claims compare against

pair_topology.note: permanent ∅_content_head, separately trained; THE registered attribution arm. The full checkpoint's eval-bypass pair_topology array is a nonbinding diagnostic only.

structure_control_6a.scoring: scaffold control shuffle_within_pair, stable-hash keyed (spec §13.18, keying canonical_pair_v1), control seed 0

comparator_note: carried over from the frozen-s0 screen; b0_cal_selfdensity is the empirically strongest arm there and remains the bar

candidate_manifest.identity_rule: every scored pair and label must match this file row-for-row

evaluator.rule: the formal gate rejects every evaluator seed other than 0

operating_point.canonical: density-matched threshold on non-self candidate rows against target_edges = |E(strip_self_loops(test))| (predecessor definition, unchanged)
operating_point.matched: per comparator: the evaluated arm realizes the comparator's exact non-self edge quota by descending pass-1 score (predecessor matched-global-RD rule, unchanged)

criteria.rule: strictly lower than every comparator at the canonical operating point
strictly higher than each comparator at that comparator's exact matched-global-RD quota
strictly higher than each comparator at that same matched quota

primary_criteria.statistics_procedure: No inferential acceptance procedure with one seed; p-values, CI pass flags, and Holm decisions are reported as not applicable

guards.name: degree_mmd_non_regression
guards.rule: full-arm degree-MMD ratio <= 1.10 x the B0 degree-MMD ratio recomputed from the frozen candidate artifact

guards.name: matched_edge_auprc
guards.rule: full-arm degree-corrected candidate AUPRC >= B0's - 0.02; B0-e2e AUPRC reported alongside as the matched (nonbinding) reference

pathway_attribution.metric: clustering_mmd_ratio at the canonical operating point
pathway_attribution.definition: G_full = clu(b0_e2e_f_only) - clu(full); G_pt = clu(b0_e2e_f_only) - clu(pair_topology [separately trained arm])
pathway_attribution.rule: applies iff primaries pass and G_full > 0: require G_pt >= 0.25 * G_full
pathway_attribution.reading_on_fail: the gain is content-side; the topology-representation claim is withdrawn from the headline
pathway_attribution.user_confirmed: 2026-07-17 review (accepted, on the separately trained arm)

structure_control_condition.rule: paired bootstrap over the 500 fixed evaluation subgraphs: shared resample indices across the two arms, B = 1000 replicates, bootstrap seed 0; require the lower bound of the two-sided 95% interval (2.5th percentile) of clu(structure_control_6a) - clu(full) to exceed 0
structure_control_condition.scope: quantifies evaluator sampling stability at the fixed training seed; explicitly NOT cross-seed or inferential evidence
structure_control_condition.reading_on_fail: the shuffled relational connectivity was not necessary beyond the retained topology-derived node features (slot tokens keep pi, m, soft degrees); this does NOT prove the whole gain is non-topological - it bounds which part of the topology pathway is load-bearing

liveness_within_checkpoint.reference: f_logit of the same checkpoint (spec §13.17 as re-registered)
liveness_within_checkpoint.death_rule: conjunctive: min_residual_std_ratio 1e-05 AND max_spearman 0.9999 AND max_topk_overlap 0.9999 at topk_fraction 0.01, residual = full - f_logit, denominator std(f_logit)
liveness_within_checkpoint.consequence: run-validity failure; gate fails closed before held-out topology metrics

e2e_rules.four_logit_decomposition: full / f_logit / pair_content / pair_topology published per scored pair for the full and p0 checkpoints, fp32, provenance egostitch_e2e_pair_fp32_v1, resolution guard per array; DIAGNOSTIC decomposition - the registered attribution arm is the separately trained pair_topology run
e2e_rules.checkpoint_selection: validation AUPRC primary; within selection_auprc_tolerance 1e-4, prefer the larger within-checkpoint std(full - f_logit)/std(f_logit) on the first max(1, ceil(0.01*N_val)) frozen validation-manifest rows (spec §13.8 as re-registered)

diagnostics_nonbinding: same-checkpoint decomposition deltas: topology_delta = full - pair_content, content_delta = full - pair_topology(bypass), and bypass-vs-trained pair_topology divergence
linear probes on frozen STE token states: R2 to degree / ego-density / clustering (ridge lambda 1e-3, 5-fold), plus degree-partialled variants and Pi-consistency
gate tanh magnitudes and per-family gradient norms over training

probe_artifact.node_selection: all operative train nodes, sorted id order
probe_artifact.pair_selection: the 4096 non-self E_msg pairs with smallest sha256('min(u,v)|max(u,v)'), or all if fewer

cost_report.requirement: measured H20 profile REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING: per-step wall, peak memory, 30-epoch extrapolation per arm (x4 arms), candidate scoring latency (x5 passes); the frozen-s0 673 s / 2.04 GiB profile explicitly does not extrapolate

verdict_rule: single-seed screening pass iff the full arm strictly dominates every comparator on all three primary criteria at the registered operating points, both guards pass, liveness passes, and both e2e_rules decision conditions pass
failure_reading: If the full arm fails the primary family against the B0+cal comparator set, the topology-conditioned encoder does not beat calibrated independent scoring at this stage; the result is written up honestly and the locked-decision discussion is taken before any Stage-2 mechanism or E1 registration. If the primaries pass but pathway attribution fails, the honest conclusion is content-side information. If the primaries pass but the structure-control condition fails, the honest conclusion is that shuffled relational connectivity was not necessary beyond the retained topology-derived node features - not that the gain is non-topological.

mechanics.worker_obligation: src/train_egostitch.py records this file's sha256 as run_metadata.json['preregistration_sha256'] at start; it refuses formal (non --max-steps) runs unless status == BINDING; --max-steps debug runs accept DRAFT but write only to *_debug output directories and produce no held-out artifacts
mechanics.gate_obligation: src/experiments/g5_stage1.py requires status == BINDING, a real b0cal_results digest in place of REQUIRED-BEFORE-BINDING, evaluator seed 0, exact frozen candidate pair/label identity, exact per-arm scoring provenance, the provenance-bound probe artifact, and this file's sha256 matching ALL FOUR formal run metadatas (full, f_only, pair_topology, p0)
mechanics.hyperparameters: spec §13.18 defaults x fixed Seed 0; no sweeps inside this screen
mechanics.p4_exclusion: no hard heuristic/feature negatives and no hard-negative checkpoint criterion are added in this revision
